 Updated: 5:39 AM CST Nov 9, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Sean Everson Meteorologist Flirting with a Top 10 Day Monday with highs climbing into the upper 60s and 70s. Meteorologist Sean Everson has the latest forecast from Omaha's Weather Leader.
 With a combined 50 years covering weather in Nebraska and Iowa, KETV NewsWatch 7 is Omaha’s Weather Leader. Led by Omaha’s Chief Meteorologist Bill Randby , the award-winning team of Sean Everson , Caitlin Harvey , and Ainsley Goebel are focused on alerting you to upcoming severe weather and KETV’s exclusive live radar gives you a 3-minute advantage when storms strike.
